title: Dolphins elevate Zane Gonzalez, Max Llewellyn

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dolphins elevate Zane Gonzalez, Max Llewellyn
sources.description: The Dolphins elevated kicker Zane Gonzalez and edge rusher Max Llewellyn to the active roster for Sunday’s game, the team announced.
